name: Frostbyte's Skip Server Movement Check
statusMeaning: Calls something that is on Kiln's roadmap. Parts of it may already run.
author: FrostbyteGames
description: A server side mod that skips the client movement check that causes rubber-banding due to "moved too quickly" or "moved wrongly".
evidence: Server-side mod: Kiln runs mods' code on Horizon's single-player server, not on dedicated servers.
